popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book XI — Socus son of Hippasus drives his spear through Odysseus' shield and into the flesh before Odysseus kills him and strips the armour: a named Trojan who wounds the Ithacan king.

popCulture.title: Socus
popCulture.description: Trojan warrior who wounded Odysseus before falling in the Iliad — not a mere catalogue name, but a fighter with a brief aristeia against the king of Ithaca.
